english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone has been made to lose face or feel ashamed.

exampleSentences.english: You really humiliate him by scolding him in front of so many people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁樣當住咁多人鬧佢，真係搞到佢冇面。
